title: Black Turtleneck & Patent Trousers
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy blonde hair sits on a gray backdrop. She wears a fitted black cropped mock-neck long-sleeve top and layered silver chain necklaces with a large star-shaped pendant. Glossy black patent trousers are cinched with a silver chain belt. Her expression is calm and serious, with glossy pink lips. Soft, even studio light with gentle shadow. Palette of black, silver, and soft gray. Bold and edgy, in the style of a high-fashion editorial.
workingNotes:
- The patent trousers and layered chains are the key contrasts.
- Keep the gray backdrop for a moody, editorial feel.
